name: generate_song
description: Music default Mureka V9.5 via fal. Use lyrics for lyrics-to-song, or prompt for prompt-to-song; prompt with lyrics supplies style. Paid audio requires approval unless autonomous. Poll get_music_task; save song_id and timed lyrics for lyrics-video. Dry-run is a preview; no training eligibility.

prompt.description: Music description. Song accepts up to 2000 characters; instrumental up to 1024. With lyrics, song prompt controls musical style.

lyrics.description: Lyrics to sing, 1 to 5000 characters. Omit for prompt-to-song.

styles.description: Prompt-to-song genres only. Cannot accompany lyrics. Allowed values: pop, rock, jazz, r&b, edm, ambient, folk, latin, k-pop, j-pop, house, gospel, lo-fi.

gender.description: Optional female or male vocal preference for lyrics-to-song.

model.description: Configured default MUREKA_MODEL=mureka-9.5. Other IDs are UNVERIFIED, preview-only and cannot submit live.

name: generate_instrumental
description: Music-bed default: Mureka V9.5 instrumental via fal. Exactly one of prompt or existing instrumental_id. Paid audio approval unless autonomous. Poll get_music_task with download=true; dry-run never produces audio.

prompt.description: Music description. Song accepts up to 2000 characters; instrumental up to 1024. With lyrics, song prompt controls musical style.

instrumental_id.description: Existing fal-hosted Mureka upload ID with purpose instrumental. Supply exactly one of this or prompt.

model.description: Configured default MUREKA_MODEL=mureka-9.5. Other IDs are UNVERIFIED, preview-only and cannot submit live.

name: generate_lyrics_video
description: Paid lyrics video via fal: exactly one of completed song_id or existing upload_audio_id. Song/upload IDs must belong to this transport. Layout/aspect and paired row or millisecond selection follow the schema. Always pause with cost approval, even autonomous. Poll get_video_task with download=true and verify saved MP4. No training eligibility.

song_id.description: Song ID from a completed Mureka fal music task. Lyrics video requires exactly one of song_id or upload_audio_id.

upload_audio_id.description: Existing fal-hosted Mureka upload ID with purpose audio. Arbitrary audio URLs are not supported by this endpoint.

layout.description: Allowed values: layout_1, layout_2, layout_3, layout_4, layout_5, layout_6, layout_7.

background_id.description: Existing Mureka upload ID with purpose lyrics-video.

cover_url.description: Public HTTPS URL or image data URI for JPG, PNG or WebP. Forbidden for layout_1.

lyrics_start_row.description: First included lyric row, starting at 1. Must pair with lyrics_end_row, without time selection.

lyrics_end_row.description: Last included lyric row, at least lyrics_start_row. Must pair with lyrics_start_row.

selection_start.description: Included audio range start in milliseconds, at least 0. Must pair with selection_end, without row selection.

selection_end.description: Included audio range end in milliseconds, strictly greater than selection_start.

name: get_music_task
description: Poll one saved Mureka music handle. Preserve song_id, duration_ms and timed lyrics_sections. download=true validates and persists completed audio; dry-run never creates artifacts.

job_id.description: Exact saved handle returned by a Mureka submit tool. Never invent IDs or submit again to poll.

download.description: Persist and validate the completed audio or MP4. Dry-run handles never produce artifacts.

name: get_video_task
description: Poll saved Mureka lyrics-video job via the shared fal queue. download=true validates saved MP4; no new generation. Dry-run handles stay previews.

job_id.description: Exact saved handle returned by a Mureka submit tool. Never invent IDs or submit again to poll.

download.description: Persist and validate the completed audio or MP4. Dry-run handles never produce artifacts.

name: list_mureka_models
description: Offline verified model and endpoint catalog; no generation or paid request.
